ICAI Declares CA Intermediate September 2026 Exam Results

The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) announced the results for the CA Intermediate September 2026 examinations on October 22. Candidates can check their scorecards and the merit list on the official website, caresults.icai.org, by entering their roll number and registration number. The exam was conducted between September 1 and September 12, 2026, with Group I papers held on September 1, 3, and 6, and Group II papers on September 8, 10, and 12. A total of 14,818 candidates passed the examination.
